groups.name: Basic inserts
groups.intro: Every other case ends in one of these. #1/#2: the edge waits on the far side and one trigger joins and inserts. #3/#4: pair already built; move it into place and insert.

groups.name: Corner on top, white facing the side
groups.intro: Move the edge so a pair can form, join it to the corner, finish with a basic insert. Recognize by edge position and top color.

groups.name: Corner on top, white facing up
groups.intro: Hardest to pair intuitively. Standard fix: R U2 R' or F' U2 F (#17-20) swings the corner so white faces the side.

groups.name: Corner in the slot, edge on top
groups.intro: Line the edge up as shown; the first moves lift the corner out already joined; none longer than 8 moves.

groups.name: Edge in the slot, corner on top
groups.intro: Pull the edge out paired with the corner. #36 is R U R' U' twice, then R U R'.

groups.name: Both pieces in the slot, solved wrong
groups.intro: Take the pair out as a unit and reinsert. Rare; learn last.

original.note: Same case as #23 with the corner at back-left, so no opening U2.
Edge swap: white-up corner above the slot, its edge stuck in back-left, back-left edge in front-right. Fixes both.
Edge swap on other slots: back-right corner on top white up, back-right edge in front-left, front-left edge in back-right. Fixes both.
Front-right corner solved; its edge is in back-left and the back-left edge is in front-right. Back-left corner on top, white up. Fixes both.
